mentions.name: dēlo
mentions.description: A small, assembly-first CAD tool for makers that sits between Tinkercad and full engineering CAD packages. It supports a workflow from modeling to exporting STL/STEP files, then slicing and 3D printing, and is local-first with no subscriptions or cloud accounts.
mentions.problem: Existing CAD tools are either too complex (full engineering CAD) or locked behind subscriptions and cloud accounts, and the author wanted a CAD they would actually enjoy using.
mentions.audience: The tool is built for makers who want simple, local-first CAD for 3D printing projects.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a small CAD tool for makers called dēlo.

I started it because I wanted a CAD I would actually enjoy using myself.
The idea is a simpler, assembly-first workflow instead of a full engineering CAD.
